isha-kriya.title: Isha Kriya
isha-kriya.subtitle: 15-minute guided meditation
isha-kriya.description: Isha Kriya is a powerful 15-minute guided meditation for health and well-being. Through this practice you will learn to use your breath, thought, and awareness in a way that greatly enhances your ability to use your mind and body.
miracle-of-mind.title: Miracle of Mind
miracle-of-mind.subtitle: 7-minute guided meditation
miracle-of-mind.description: A powerful guided meditation designed by Sadhguru. It takes only 7 minutes a day. With clear step-by-step instructions and gentle bells, this practice establishes a solid foundation for mental well-being. Perfect for beginners and daily practice.
nada-yoga.title: Nada Yoga
nada-yoga.subtitle: The yoga of inner sound
nada-yoga.description: Nada Yoga is the science of using sound and vibration to transcend the limits of being. Sound is not just a means of communication, it is a bridge to the infinite. Through AUM chanting and deep listening of the inner sound, this practice takes you beyond mental noise toward inner peace.
yoga-namaskar.title: Yoga Namaskar
yoga-namaskar.subtitle: 10-minute morning routine
yoga-namaskar.description: Yoga Namaskar is a complete 10-minute sequence to stretch and strengthen the back. This powerful morning practice activates the lumbar region of the spine and strengthens the muscles along it. Ideal for beginners, it can be done at home, at the office, or in the park.
nadi-shuddhi.title: Nadi Shuddhi
nadi-shuddhi.subtitle: Cleansing of the energy channels
nadi-shuddhi.description: Nadi Shuddhi is a simple yet powerful 5-minute practice that cleanses the nadis, the channels through which pranic energy flows. This practice results in a balanced system and psychological well-being. Guided by Sadhguru.
chit-shakti-salud.title: Chit Shakti for Health
chit-shakti-salud.subtitle: Free guided meditation
chit-shakti-salud.description: Chit Shakti is a powerful guided meditation that uses the power of the mind to create your reality. This practice is designed for health and well-being. Through affirmations and guided visualization by Sadhguru, activate the healing energy within you.
chit-shakti-amor.title: Chit Shakti for Love
chit-shakti-amor.subtitle: Free guided meditation
chit-shakti-amor.description: Chit Shakti is a powerful guided meditation that uses the power of the mind to create your reality. This practice is designed to open your heart to love in all its forms. Guided by Sadhguru, it uses affirmations and visualization to cultivate love and compassion.
no-soy-el-cuerpo.title: I am not the Body — Neither am I the Mind
no-soy-el-cuerpo.subtitle: 7 minutes to remember your true nature
no-soy-el-cuerpo.description: A deep meditation based on advaita teaching. By affirming "I am not the Body" on the inhale and "Neither am I the Mind" on the exhale, you transcend limiting identifications and awaken to your true essence.
yoga-exito.title: Yoga for Success
yoga-exito.subtitle: 5 minutes
yoga-exito.description: A short yoga practice guided by Sadhguru to activate the energy of success in your system. In just 5 minutes, align your body and mind to attract prosperity and achievements.
yoga-espalda.title: Yoga for Back Pain
yoga-espalda.subtitle: 10 minutes
yoga-espalda.description: A 10-minute practice guided by Sadhguru to relieve back pain. Stretch and strengthen your spine with gentle, mindful movements.
explorar-interior.title: Explore Your Inner Self
explorar-interior.subtitle: 5 minutes
explorar-interior.description: A 5-minute guided meditation to explore your inner world. Sadhguru takes you into the depths of your being on this introspective journey.
isha-upa-yoga.title: Isha Upa Yoga
isha-upa-yoga.subtitle: Guided practices
isha-upa-yoga.description: A collection of guided Isha Upa Yoga practices with Sadhguru. These powerful routines are designed to activate the joints, rejuvenate the system, and bring health and well-being to your life.
step.s000: Find a quiet place. Sit upright but relaxed. Gently close your eyes.
step.s001: Take three deep breaths to let go of the day.
step.s002: Slowly bring your awareness back to the space around you.
step.s003: When you feel ready, gently open your eyes.
step.s007: Bring attention to your feet... toes, sole, heel...
step.s012: Now feel your body as a whole, a field of vibrant energy.
step.s014: Silence... feel the echo of the vibration within you.
step.s015: A thought appears... observe it... let it go...
step.s016: Another thought appears... don\'t judge it... just release it...
step.s017: Between thoughts, there is a space... remain there...
step.s018: That space is you. Not the thoughts.
step.s019: Thank your lungs for every breath they give you.
step.s020: Thank your eyes for everything they allow you to see.
step.s021: Thank your ears for the sounds that connect you to the world.
step.s022: Thank your feet that support you day after day.
step.s023: Thank the sun, the air, the water, the earth that sustain you.
step.s024: Thank every person who has crossed your path and taught you something.
step.s025: Thank existence itself for the miracle of being here, now.
step.s029: Find a quiet place where you won\'t be disturbed. Sit in a comfortable but upright posture.
step.s030: Take three deep breaths to prepare for this practice.
step.s031: Next, we will play the guided video. Just follow the instructions.
step.s032: Playing Isha Kriya — Follow Sadhguru\'s guidance
step.s033: The practice has ended. Sit in silence for a moment and observe how you feel.
step.s034: Carry this experience with you throughout the rest of the day.
step.s038: Bring your attention to the center of your chest. Feel your heart beating.
step.s039: Visualize a soft light in the center of your chest expanding with each breath.
step.s040: That light is you. Rest in it.
step.s042: Observe your natural breath. Without control, just observe.
step.s043: Each inhale brings new energy. Each exhale releases tension.
step.s044: Rest in the awareness of your own existence.
step.s045: Gently move your fingers and toes.
step.s046: Carry this peace with you throughout the rest of the day.
step.s047: Sit upright with your spine straight. Gently close your eyes.
step.s048: Take three deep breaths to connect with yourself.
step.s049: Breathe in deeply. As you exhale, intone AUM...
step.s050: Listen to the silence after the sound. That is where the real practice lies.
step.s051: Playing Nada Yoga — Follow Sadhguru\'s guidance
step.s053: There is a sound that does not need to be produced. Only listened to.
step.s055: Sound and silence are one. Carry this awareness with you.
step.s056: Find a space where you can move freely. Wear comfortable clothes.
step.s057: Stand upright, feet together, hands at your sides. Breathe deeply.
step.s058: We will follow the guided practice on video. Follow the instructions at your own pace.
step.s060: Sit or lie down for a moment. Feel the energy in your spine.
step.s061: Carry this vitality with you for the rest of the day.
step.s062: Find a quiet place. Sit upright with your spine straight.
step.s063: Take three deep breaths to prepare.
step.s064: Playing Nadi Shuddhi — Follow Sadhguru\'s guidance
step.s065: Sit in silence for a moment. Feel the flow of energy in your system.
step.s066: Carry this lightness with you throughout the rest of the day.
step.s067: Playing Chit Shakti for Health — Follow Sadhguru\'s guidance
step.s068: The practice has ended. Sit in silence for a moment.
step.s069: Carry this energy with you throughout the rest of the day.
step.s070: Take three deep breaths to connect with your heart.
step.s071: Playing Chit Shakti for Love — Follow Sadhguru\'s guidance
step.s072: The practice has ended. Feel the love in your heart.
step.s073: Carry this love with you throughout the rest of the day.
step.s077: Find a space where you can move freely.
step.s078: Playing Yoga for Success — Follow along
step.s079: Take a moment to feel the energy in your body.
step.s080: Find a comfortable place to practice. Wear loose clothing.
step.s081: Playing Yoga for Back Pain — Follow along
step.s082: Lie down for a moment and feel your spine released.
step.s083: Sit upright and close your eyes.
step.s084: Playing Explore Your Inner Self — Follow along

step.s086: Prepare a space where you can move freely.
